title: Per-county value of production by commodity (Atlas exposure), Kenya
source: Africa Agriculture Adaptation Atlas combined exposure — MapSPAM 2020 v1r2 (crops) + GLW4 (livestock)
source_file: D409 _master/harmonized/atlas_exposure.csv (Kenya subset of the hub snapshot, pulled 2026-07-09)
method: Deterministic filter + label (_sources/parse_exposure.py), no LLM/transcription. Kept exposure='vop', unit='intld15' (constant international dollars), adm1 (gaul2_code blank); crops via tech='all' (all-technology aggregate), livestock via tech='' (GLW4 has no technology dimension), excluding 'total-*' livestock roll-ups. Livestock species merged across highland/tropical agro-zones to one commodity (Cattle, Goats, ...). VoP values are the hub's own, passed through verbatim.
grain: one row per county x commodity

columns.commodity: crop (MapSPAM) or livestock species (GLW4), display label
columns.vop_intld15: gross value of production, constant 2015 international dollars (I$)

coverage: 1156 rows, 47 counties, 34 commodities. Snapshot (SPAM 2020 / GLW4) - no year dimension. In the arid/semi-arid counties livestock dominates VoP (Marsabit/Turkana: cattle+goats+sheep), grounding the pastoralist framing.
